translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Kala katumigileu vivila avai tuta bogwa eivalulu
E Guyau iluki Mosese sola Eroni karaiwaga makwaisina
paila kasi karaiwaga mina Isireli. Ka, kidamwa natana vivila bitapoi yamala, e latula tau, kwailima kwaiyu yam minana bisisu wala napupagatu makawala wala igau kala tubukona buyavila eitalagila.
E kwailima kwaitolula yam gwadi magudina biboda kala bobu.

Oluvi kweluwotolu kwaitolu yam tuvaila minana bogwa wala bimigileu metoya buyavila eititalagila, minana gala wala ibodi bikabikoni avai vavagi kwebumaboma kaina bisuvi Guyau ola Buliyoyova kwebumaboma, tatoula wala bivigimkulovaisi kala katumigileu.

E kidamwa natana vivila bitapoi yamala e latula vivila, kweluwotala kwaivasi yam minana bisisu wala napupagatu, makawala wala igau kala tubukona buyavila eititalagila. Oluvi kweluwolima kweluwotala kwailima kwaitala (66) yam tuvaila, minana bogwa bimigileu metoya buyavila eititalagila.

Avai tuta minana yamla kala katumigileu bogwa biwokuva, kaina paila latula tau, kaina vivila, minana ibodi bimiaki tolula natana lam kala taitu kwaitala paila lula kwegubugabu deli natana bubuna kaina buneroro paila mitugaga lulela, omatala Guyau la Buliyoyova.

E tolula bikau vivila minana la semakavi bisaiki Guyau, oluvi bivagi kabotuvitusila avaka kasi gulogula paila kala katumigileu vivila minana, e minana bogwa bimigileu. Baisa makawala vivila ibodi bivagaisi avai tuta bogwa eitapoi yumasi.

Kidamwa vivila minana gala iyosi natana lam, minana ibodi bimai nayu bubuna kaina nayu buneroro, natana paila lula kwegubugabu, e nayuwela paila mitugaga lulela, e tolula bivagi kabotuvitusila avaka kasi gulogula paila kala katumigileu vivila minana, e minana bogwa wala bimigileu.
